files.html:
## 0.1.6. Changelog
## Added

- Added NPC burst fire.
- Added the armor pool feature and armor pool editing UI.
- Added expanded Chinese and Japanese translation keys.

## Fixed

- Fixed vanilla melee swing playback when Better Combat is not installed.
- Improved NPC melee/ranged weapon switching stability.
- Fixed NPC gun aiming and melee poses mixing together.
- Improved CustomNPCs init event handling when opening and closing the NPC GUI.
- Fixed NPCs holding TACZ ammo or magazine items in the offhand during reload.
- Fixed profile import failures.
